stimulus: Many people dream of having a highly paid and (a) ------- job that is admired by society. While such jobs are popular, there are also some fun, exciting, and even strange (b) ------- that people may not consider. These include picking chewing gum from benches, testing furniture comfort, or farming oysters in the middle of the (c) -------. Though unusual, these are real jobs done by real people who earn money and enjoy what they do. These careers may seem (d) ------- or weird, but they are important in their own way. Sometimes, choosing such a job is a matter of (e) ------- and passion. ■■■ ■■■
guide_solution: Ans. (a) high-profile; (b) careers; (c) ocean; (d) unconventional; (e) choice;
